thread:
Rafael Mendes: hey folks — need to lock game day scheduling + roles for the controlled failover test (staging first). aiming for next week so we can keep momentum on ENG-2850. what windows work?

Tomáš Novák: +1. also want to get the checklist finalized today so we can send the “what to expect” note to oncall + support.

Miles Thornton: preference is Tue/Wed PT morning. we need Smart Routing + Infra on for the routing/DNS bits, so not Friday.

Mina Haddad: Wed AM PT works for routing. Tues I’m out most of the day.

Irene Choi: infra can support Wed. pls avoid 11-1 PT (team sync + vendor call). :grimacing:

Victor Alvarez: Wed 9:30–10:30 PT is clean for me. if there’s any external DNS TTL change, I want at least a 24h heads-up.

Connor O'Brien: release eng is good Wed morning. reminder: anything touching prod routing policy store requires change record + 2 approvals. staging we can do lighter, but still want a rollback plan documented.

Rafael Mendes: ok let’s target **Wed 9:30–11:00 PT** (gives buffer). staging only.

Aisha Bello: works. are we doing “monitor-only” trigger engine or allowing it to actually flip state in staging?

Miles Thornton: staging should be “active” end-to-end (trigger -> orchestrator -> routing policy update), but with blast radius limited (only staging traffic + perf canary). no manual poking besides starting the impairment.

Tomáš Novák: can we align on roles now?

Rafael Mendes: proposal:
- IC: me
- Deputy/ops: Miles
- Comms (internal + support liaison): Tomáš
- Scribe: Aisha (captures timeline + checklist outcomes)
- Routing subject matter: Mina
- Infra/networking: Irene + Victor (on standby)
- Observability/alerts: Sergio
- Control plane: Ethan

Tomáš Novák: works. for comms I’ll handle internal announcements + the “if you get paged” note. for customer-facing: since staging, just need Support heads-up. @Dev Patel can you be backup point of contact in case Support pings?

Dev Patel: yep. staging is usually quiet but I’ll keep an eye. if you can drop the exact window + expected symptoms, I’ll share with Owen too.

Sergio Costa: I can own dashboards + alert silencing guidance. for staging we should *not* silence; better to see what would page. but we can route to #eng-sre instead of paging humans.

Aisha Bello: :thumbsup: agree. we should record which alerts fired and whether they were useful vs noise.

Ethan Park: I can be there. question: are we toggling any feature flags manually at start? or pre-enabled?

Miles Thornton: pre-enable in staging 30 mins before (flag + config). during game day we only introduce impairment + observe. if we have to override, that’s a learning.

Connor O'Brien: please document flag state + rollback steps in the checklist (exact commands / where in console).

Tomáš Novák: checklist draft is here (Drive): https://drive.google.com/.../game-day-checklist (still WIP). I’ll move the latest into Confluence after we agree.

Rafael Mendes: can we list the scenario + stop conditions in-thread so we’re all aligned?

Miles Thornton: scenario proposal (staging):
1) Induce partial impairment in us-east (network packet loss from probes + elevated 5xx from one upstream dependency simulator)
2) Validate health aggregator sees signal (error rate + p95 latency + synthetic probe fail)
3) Trigger engine enters DEGRADED then FAILOVER_CANDIDATE
4) “safe-to-failover” checks pass (target region headroom + dependency health)
5) Orchestrator shifts routing 10% -> 50% -> 100% (staging traffic only)

Stop conditions (immediate abort + rollback):
- target region queue depth > threshold for >2m
- canary requests error rate > 2% sustained 2 windows
- orchestrator flaps state >1 transition within hold-down
- any unexpected cross-env spillover (prod metrics impacted)

Victor Alvarez: +1. also add: if routing policy store update fails or is inconsistent (split brain), we stop and revert to baseline policy.

Mina Haddad: for progressive routing: can we do 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%? smaller steps lets us see saturation earlier.

Miles Thornton: fine by me. we’ll mirror what we want in prod anyway.

Sergio Costa: I’ll prepare a quick “game day view” dashboard filter for staging namespace + canary. also want a panel for state transitions + hold-down timer.

Aisha Bello: for SLO angle: I’ll add a section to capture “time to detect” and “time to mitigation” even though it’s staging. we should measure the delta vs manual.

Connor O'Brien: change mgmt: staging change record not required, but please do a short PRD-ish note in the Confluence plan with:
- who can flip manual override
- expected duration
- explicit rollback owner

Tomáš Novák: noted. I’ll add a “manual override policy” snippet + link the runbook section once it’s updated.

Ethan Park: on control plane side, I want to confirm RBAC in staging is set so IC/deputy can hit override endpoint. we had issues last time where only infra-admin could.

Rafael Mendes: good call. I’ll file an action item for today to validate staging RBAC + incident bot access.

Irene Choi: capacity: I’ll pull current staging GPU pool headroom in us-west + eu-west and paste into checklist before Wed. staging is usually fine but want numbers.

Dev Patel: for Support heads-up: what symptoms might show up even in staging? just so macros aren’t confusing.

Tomáš Novák: likely: brief elevated latency, some 5xx during transition, possible streaming disconnects (if any staging consumers are watching). will message as “planned reliability test; no customer impact expected; internal monitoring only”.

Rafael Mendes: action items before Wed:
- Tomáš: finalize checklist + send internal note (incl roles + link) by EOD Thu
- Miles: confirm impairment mechanism + rollback toggle steps (copy/paste commands ok)
- Sergio: dashboard link + alert routing plan for staging
- Ethan: RBAC sanity check + confirm override endpoint access
- Irene/Victor: confirm routing/DNS plan is staging-only + no TTL changes needed

Mina Haddad: can you add me to the calendar invite w/ link to the staging routing policy doc? I want to sanity check the route scoping.

Rafael Mendes: yep. I’ll send invite today. thanks all.

Sergio Costa: :eyes: pls also include which channel we’re running live coordination in. #incidents vs #eng-sre?

Rafael Mendes: we’ll do coordination in #incidents for muscle memory, but I’ll post a pointer in #eng-sre. observers can stay here for async.

Tomáš Novák: :thumbsup: I’ll make sure the checklist includes “open #incidents thread + assign scribe” as step 0.

Connor O'Brien: +1. and please paste the rollback plan at top of the #incidents thread when you start.

Aisha Bello: I’ll prep a retro template snippet so we don’t forget to capture what was noisy / missing.

Rafael Mendes: perfect. locking Wed 9:30–11 PT unless anyone screams in next hour.

Victor Alvarez: no screams. :ok_hand:

Mina Haddad: good.

Irene Choi: works.

Dev Patel: good from Support.
